items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Then old man Petit, he used to play with us too sometimes.

ctx.x: Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton for a while. Mm-hm. And then I played with Lewis Dorman band. Mm-hm. And Auguste Dush . I played with Sam Morgan for a good while. Mm-hm. I played a little while with Joe Howell. And that kid Howell I played with him- I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him. That's right. The boys wouldn't stick with him on account of Frankie Ducey, we all quit. He had a good band too. The kid Howard, I…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Ask him who was in the band when Muck Carey was in the band, I'd be. Right. Yeah, when he finishes there. Then I, uh. He said who was in the band when Muck Carey was there?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Yeah, I think Buddy Petit died, you know. Buddy used to get drunk so much, you know. But I always liked his playing. Yeah, Buddy was good, yeah.

ctx.x: So what about the trumpet players? In the outside, Joe Oliver and Guy Kelly and, let's see, Prince. What about Buddy Petit? Yeah, Buddy Petit. Yeah, Buddy Petit. Yeah, I think Buddy Petit died, you know. Buddy used to get drunk so much, you know. But I always liked his playing. Yeah, Buddy was good, yeah. Yeah. And, let me see, that brother man. George McCullum, you remember him? Yeah, I remember him. Yeah, I remember him. Yeah, I remember him. Him and his dad both played. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Sometimes I remember Petit we played with him.

ctx.x: Ask him, who did Zeb work with?

Who did Zeb work with? Zeb? Buddy Petit, yeah. Zeb? When I was here. Were you working with Jack when Jack was working with him? No. He used to work with Jack. He stayed with kids with her a long time. And he stayed with Buddy. Me and him was the guy that was Buddy, you see. But Peter, he had left him there. He went to Chicago. He had to talk to Peter, eh? He had to get a little, little satin kind of, uh, the Peter couldn't read and lit. You know, I used to show him some time. But he told me, don't tell him fellas…
Well, what about, uh, who did George Lewis work with other than him?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Buddy put up some music one night and told Zeb if he didn't play this he's going to kick him off the bandstand... I was playing with him then.

ctx.x: Ask him did Buddy ever make any records?

Did Buddy Petit ever make any records? Well, I can't remember Lexi and Nate with some other bands. Cause sometimes them fellas were higher when they were on different fellas out there band to make records, you know. I never really had to make a record, you know. I used to play the radio, though. Sometimes when we get together, I couldn't get them fellas. I used to play piano sometimes. What I know, you see, compliment.
